title: Configure, upgrade and troubleshoot providers
intro: `/home/coder/lab` was applied last week. Since then a colleague changed the `logs` module, and now `terraform init` fails. **No existing resource may be recreated in this lab.** Open a terminal via **☰ → Terminal → New Terminal**.

tasks.text: Find out why `terraform init` fails and fix it in the `logs` module. Don't change the root module's AWS version constraint.
Add a second AWS provider configuration with the alias `west` for `us-west-2`. Create `aws_vpc.dr` (`10.20.0.0/16`, tag `Name = dr`) in that region.
Upgrade the `random` provider to the newest `3.6.x` release: allow `3.6.x` in the constraint and update the dependency lock file.
Every VPC in both regions must carry the tag `ManagedBy = terraform` without repeating it on each resource. Finish with `terraform plan` reporting no changes.
